content:
The **Monongah Overlook** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. It is an old tourist overlook dedicated to the valley surrounding Grafton. 

The overlook offers stunning views of the Toxic Valley, and has some harvestable resources like Wild Blackberry and wild Carrot Flowers. There is a mysterious button in the lefthand port-a-potty, which is the emergency exit of Site Bravo. The nearby wrecked truck contains a Wooden Crate and a Toolbox. East of the overlook, along Route 95, is an old Raider checkpoint, possibly inhabited by Super Mutants.

This location is the map-marked location for taking down a Yao Guai as part of Flavors of Mayhem, however, it is not specifically required to be done here.

Bird watching list - Note, can be found on a picnic table on the wooden platform of the overlook.

The Monongah Overlook appears in *Fallout 76*.

Entrance

Overlook

Route 95 leading out of the overlook, towards an unmarked checkpoint
